answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance comes from each identity maintaining a live willow of continuous non-replicable real-time attestations tied to a unique hardware fingerprint. An attacker spinning many fakes must pay the full compute and bandwidth cost for each, while honest agents refresh only their single willow. A forged pearl of reputation is revealed when the zephyr of matching response latencies across clones fails under load, slashing the cluster bonds. This makes large-scale sybil farms unviable as costs scale linearly with identities.
